reason: Object-member string validation is a supported unpack behavior. The fixed target looks up the member with {s?o}, but o accepts its value without string validation. Its json_unpack calls also provide no error sink, so the keyed diagnostic cannot be exposed.
finite_witness: A selector byte 0x00 followed by the UTF-8 bytes for {"data":42}. With the supported setup json_unpack_ex(root, &error, 0, "{ss}", "data"), the integer member triggers the keyed string diagnostic. The fixed target instead calls json_unpack(root, "{s?o}", "data", &field).

scope_contract.reason: The target unpacks parsed object members. The changed unpack contract supports an s value type guard that includes the member key; the API suite demonstrates that diagnostic.

feasible_trigger.reason: The input model permits a selector byte followed by a valid object containing an integer data member. A supported {ss} unpack setup would dispatch that member to the s guard; the target fixes the value token to o.

evidence.dependency_reason: The member value and key are supplied to the value-format dispatcher.
